author: Aswath Damodaran

observable_conditions.observation: The core business intermediates financial assets, takes deposits, issues insurance obligations, or otherwise uses funding liabilities as an operating input
observable_conditions.measurement: Confirm in issuer business descriptions and balance-sheet/liability notes, not only industry label

observable_conditions.observation: Regulatory equity/capital requirements constrain balance-sheet growth or distributions
observable_conditions.measurement: Issuer regulatory-capital disclosure and applicable current local regime

routes.why_generic_model_needs_adaptation: Ordinary FCFF debt/capex/noncash-working-capital categories may not represent financial operating economics. Enterprise debt subtraction and WACC using customer deposits can be misleading.
preferred_model_families: equity dividend discount with sustainable payout review
equity cashflow based on regulatory-capital reinvestment
permitted_relative_models: PE with earnings quality, growth, payout and cost-of-equity comparability
PB with forward profitability/ROE and risk comparability
routes.not_a_rule: Financial-sector PE is not forbidden by the author; do not block it categorically. A raw common PER is insufficient when loan provisions or business mix differ.

author_model_formula.scope: Simplified equity cashflow relation on PDF22; regulatory capital, growth and profitability assumptions must be explicit. Do not reuse example capital ratios.

required_inputs: current and forward net income / accounting scope
book equity and regulatory-capital definition
current required capital and sourced target capital policy
growth in risk/earning assets and resulting equity reinvestment
forward ROE and return persistence
cost of equity, currency, valuation date and source
sustainable actual/potential dividends
loan-loss provision and asset-quality comparability
business-line mix and separate models where materially different
dilution or new equity funding assumptions where relevant
routes.if_inputs_missing: Retain financial equity specialist review. Do not use ordinary FCFF with guessed debt/WACC or automatically exclude the issuer.

project_adoption.adopted_by: project agent under user instruction to use existing author policies
project_adoption.purpose: Select an appropriate research model and identify missing inputs; not activate a financial parameter, contact or order

routes.missing_input_behavior: unresolved or specialist_model_review; do not synthesize forecast inputs
routes.evidence_requirement: Issuer public disclosure and dated numerical data; sector tag alone is not conclusive

observable_conditions.observation: Issuer evidence links earnings or cashflows materially to an economic/commodity cycle
observable_conditions.measurement: Read business risk/sensitivity disclosures and compare historical revenues/margins with the identified driver

observable_conditions.observation: Current profit or reinvestment is at an atypical cycle point
observable_conditions.measurement: Assess against a sourced history covering a full cycle; no volatility cutoff supplied by the author

observable_conditions.observation: A commodity producer has finite reserves or operating resource life
observable_conditions.measurement: Review reserves, production and resource-life disclosures if applicable

routes.why_generic_model_needs_adaptation: Current peak/trough earnings, returns, reinvestment and financing costs are not automatically sustainable inputs. A low spot PE can be a high-cycle denominator effect.
preferred_model_families: cycle-normalized DCF with consistent reinvestment and financing assumptions
normalized earnings multiples with comparable risk and growth
explicit finite-life resource model when applicable

normalization_methods.caution: Changing issuer scale can make past absolute averages inappropriate

normalization_methods.method: historical average margin applied to current revenue scale
normalization_methods.caution: Need consistent accounting and evidence that historical margins remain relevant

normalization_methods.method: cycle-average sector margins when issuer history is limited
normalization_methods.caution: Must account for issuer-specific economics; do not treat sector mean as automatic truth

required_inputs: identified macro/commodity driver and date
income/cashflow history with accounting/scope consistency
evidence that history covers a complete cycle
normalization method and current issuer scale
normalized margin or earnings with source
normalized reinvestment, returns and financing cost
recovery path distinct from long-run normal growth
commodity price/volume/cost and reserve life if relevant
survival/financing constraints during downturns
current market price and separate adopted decision conditions
routes.normalization_window_rule: Evidence of a full cycle; do not hardcode 5,7 or10 years from illustrative ranges
routes.double_count_guard: Do not both replace trough earnings with normal earnings and add the entire rebound growth a second time.
routes.if_inputs_missing: Current EPS×PER or a one-period DCF is not sufficient for ordinary valuation. Keep unresolved and request public historical/driver evidence, not an industry exclusion.

observable_conditions.observation: Young business has short/incomplete operating history and operating losses or little revenue
observable_conditions.measurement: Issuer financial statements and business commercialization history

observable_conditions.observation: Expected revenue growth/profitability depends on a transition not demonstrated by current earnings
observable_conditions.measurement: Published product/customer/business evidence and explicit forecast drivers

observable_conditions.observation: External funding or dilution may be required before positive cashflow
observable_conditions.measurement: Balance-sheet cash, debt maturity, cashflow forecast and financing terms; no generic runway cutoff

routes.why_generic_model_needs_adaptation: Loss-year PE is not an ordinary comparable positive-earnings multiple. A stable-margin one-period DCF can conceal the revenue/margin transition, cash needs and probability of failure. DCF itself remains a valid framework when the transitions are explicit.
preferred_model_families: multi-stage DCF with sourced revenue, margins and reinvestment pathways
explicit survival/distress adjustment on a consistently defined value basis
relative valuation only with suitable denominator, comparability and survival treatment
routes.not_a_rule: Negative profit alone does not prove a young-growth route; mature cyclical distress or one-off accounting losses require separate cause review.

author_model_formula.scope: Firm/value basis consistent across both scenarios before any equity bridge; see PDF42. No default failure probability or distress value.

required_inputs: commercial revenue drivers, market size and achievable share with evidence
revenue growth path and expected duration
steady-state operating margin and pathway to reach it
reinvestment required for growth, capacity and human/R&D capital
cash needs, financing capacity and ownership dilution
tax loss carryforwards and applicable tax rules
discount-rate/risk path consistent with business maturation
stable growth conditions and terminal assumptions
sourced survival/failure probability over a specified horizon
distress value on same scope/currency/date as going-concern value
net debt and other equity claims if bridging to common equity
routes.if_inputs_missing: Unresolved model review; do not assign survival=1, borrow dated US startup failure rates as Japanese-company defaults, or automatically discard the firm.

common_dispatch.input: Issuer evidence and model input packet
common_dispatch.unknown_evidence: unresolved; absence of data is not proof of a normal industrial business
common_dispatch.multiple_routes: Collect all applicable flags and review composition; no unsupported universal route precedence
common_dispatch.ordinary_route: Requires positive evidence that the chosen model inputs are appropriate; not established just because no exception matched
common_dispatch.negative_or_zero_eps: Review earnings cause; do not use an ordinary positive-earnings comparable PE on zero/loss earnings
common_dispatch.output: model family and missing input checklist only, never buy/sell/exclusion
common_dispatch.code_integration: Not implemented by this artifact; routing fields are research contracts only

non_adopted_author_examples: company-specific beta, cost of equity and risk premium
toy bank capital ratios and profitability
startup example failure probabilities and terminal growth
mandatory industry filters or loss thresholds
